title: Looking Up After Sunset
context: Julia 和朋友 Ben 在楼顶观星，发现云层遮住一部分天空，决定先观察较亮的星星。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和练习题均为原创，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.en: The sky is getting dark. Can you see any stars yet?
dialogue.zh: 天渐渐黑了。你看到星星了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I can see one bright star above that building.
dialogue.zh: 我能看到那栋楼上方有一颗明亮的星星。

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.en: I see it now. The clouds are covering the other side.
dialogue.zh: 我现在看到了。云挡住了另一边的天空。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Let's give our eyes a little time to adjust.
dialogue.zh: 让我们的眼睛花一点时间适应吧。

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.en: Good idea. I'll dim my phone screen, too.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我也把手机屏幕调暗。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Can you tell me what those stars are called?
dialogue.zh: 你能告诉我那一组星星叫什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.en: Not yet. I brought a star map, so we can look it up.
dialogue.zh: 还不知道。我带了星图，我们可以查一查。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: The map says this shape is the Big Dipper.
dialogue.zh: 星图上说这个形状是北斗七星。

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.en: I can see the handle now that you point it out.
dialogue.zh: 你指给我看之后，我现在能看出它的柄了。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: The clouds are moving away. There are more stars over there.
dialogue.zh: 云正在飘走。那边还有更多星星。

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.en: Let's stay a little longer and see what else we can find.
dialogue.zh: 我们再待一会儿，看看还能发现什么。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I'd like that. The view is worth the wait.

expressions.example: I'll look up the name in my guide.

expressions.zh: 适应变化，如光线的变化。
expressions.example: Give your eyes time to adjust to the dark.
She pointed out a bird in the tree.
The clouds moved away from the mountain.
The meal took a while, but it was worth the wait.

pronunciation: stargazing 重读第一个音节 STAR；在 bright star 中保留 bright 末尾的 /t/，再接 star 开头的 /s/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Night skies
practice.prompt: Do you ever look at the night sky?
practice.answer: Yes, especially when I visit somewhere away from bright city lights. I enjoy looking for a few familiar groups of stars.

practice.title: Part 2 · An evening outdoors
practice.prompt: Describe an evening you spent outdoors. Say where you were, who was with you, and what you saw.
practice.answer: One clear evening I went up to a rooftop with a friend to look at the sky. At first clouds covered part of it, so we waited and let our eyes adjust to the dark. We used a star map to identify the Big Dipper, and my friend pointed out its handle. Later the clouds moved away and we saw more stars. It was a quiet evening that made me feel relaxed. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Seeing the sky
practice.prompt: Why can it be difficult to see stars in a city?
practice.answer: Bright lights and tall buildings can make the night sky harder to see. Places with less artificial light can give people a better chance to notice faint stars.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读观星对话，再描述天空的变化，并建议用星图查找。
practice.answer: I can see a bright star above that building. The clouds are moving away now. Let's look up that group of stars on the map.
